description: This Java class defines a REST API controller that handles HTTP requests related to Project entities, including getting, creating, deleting, and updating projects. It uses Spring Framework annotations and relies on a ProjectService for business logic.

classes.name: ProjectRestEndpoint
classes.description: A REST controller exposing endpoints for managing projects, including get, create, delete, and update operations.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a project by ID and returns the project as a REST resource.

methods.name: createProject
methods.description: Handles requests to create a new project from a ProjectResource payload.

methods.name: deleteProject
methods.description: Deletes a project identified by project ID.

methods.name: updateProject
methods.description: Updates an existing project using a ProjectResource payload.
